With $\beta>0$ and real $x$:
\begin{eqnarray}
\frac{1}{e^{\beta x}+1} &=& \frac{1}{2}\left(1-\tanh\frac{\beta x}{2}\right) \nonumber\\
&=& \frac{e^{-\beta x/2}}{e^{\beta x/2}+e^{-\beta x/2}} .
\label{eq:e1}
\end{eqnarray}
\[ \sum_{\pm} \frac{1}{e^{\pm\beta x}+1} = 1 \]
$$ \frac{1}{e^{\beta x}+1} + \frac{1}{e^{-\beta x}+1} = 1 $$
\begin{gather}
a+b = b+a \\
\frac{1}{e^{\beta x}-1} + \frac{1}{e^{-\beta x}-1} = -1
\end{gather}
\begin{multline}
\frac{1}{e^{\beta x}+1} \\
= \frac{1}{2} - \frac{1}{2}\tanh\frac{\beta x}{2}
\end{multline}
